description: Application for Non-Material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/24/01789, Dated 01/07/2025.Non Material amendment(s) Sought: Changing of wordings to condition 6 0- working timing as follwing: All demolition, building, engineering or other operations associated with the construction of the development (including arrival, departure and loading and unloading of construction vehicles) shall be carried out in general accordance with the latest, current published Tower Hamlets Code of Construction Practice. No construction activities shall take place outside of the hours of 08:00 - 18:00 on Mondays to Fridays or the hours of 09.00 - 13.00 on Saturdays and none at all on, Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays, unless allowed by a consent granted under Section 61 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974. No high impact construction activities (piling, excavation and demolition) shall take place outside of the hours of 09:00 - 12:00 and 14:00 - 17:30 Mondays to Fridays or at all on Saturdays, Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays, unless allowed by a consent granted under Section 61 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974. Ground-borne vibration shall not exceed 1.0mm/s Peak Particle Velocity (PPV) at residential and 3.0mm/s PPV at commercial properties neighbouring the site. Noise levels measured 1 metre from the fa‡ade of any occupied building neighbouring the site shall not exceed 70dB(LAeqT*) at any point 1m from the fa‡ade of residential and noise sensitive commercial properties Monday to Friday, reduced to 65dB(LAeqT) at schools and hospitals and other noise sensitive premises.*(LAeq,T where T = 10 hours Monday to Friday).
